body.title: Add CommandProfile and project-type detection
body.summary: Add the CommandProfile type, InvalidCommandSetting error and a detector that reads root marker files (package.json, pyproject.toml/setup.py, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pom.xml/build.gradle/build.sbt) to give node, python, go, rust, jvm or unknown. Several markers of different types give unknown. Include the per-type guidance table used only for prompt text. The Node default reproduces today's TYPECHECK_ARGV, TEST_RUNNER_ARGV and TAP format. No behaviour change yet.
acceptanceChecks: A temp repo holding only package.json is detected as node, and likewise pyproject.toml python, go.mod go, Cargo.toml rust, pom.xml jvm
No marker or markers of different types give unknown
The Node default profile equals today's argv constants and tap format
The guidance table has an entry for every detected type including unknown, so the prompt can render all of them

tests.name: src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validation-checks.test.ts: project type is detected from root marker files and mixed or no markers give unknown
src/daemon/steps/build-step/__tests__/validation-checks.test.ts: the Node default profile equals today's argv and tap format
